name: LDAP Server Certificate
description:
# Fetch an LDAP Server Certificate

Make a POST request to this resource with `server_uri` (an LDAP server URI, as `AUTH_LDAP_SERVER_URI` takes it) to read the certificate chain the first server that answers presents: `ldaps://` servers when they connect, `ldap://` servers after Start TLS. The chain is not checked. The response lists each certificate with its SHA-256 fingerprint, says whether the system trust store already accepts it (`trusted`), and gives in `ca_cert` the certificates to put in `AUTH_LDAP_CA_CERT`: the certificate authorities the server sent, or its own certificate when it sent no other (`leaf_only`).

server_uri.label: LDAP Server URI
server_uri.help_text: URI of the LDAP server to read the certificate of, such as "ldaps://ldap.example.com:636". With several URIs, the first one that answers is read.
